target.title: feat(status): surface last compaction outcome in /status
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Compaction attempts already get classified into stable reason buckets (`classifyCompactionReason`: `summary_failed`, `timeout`, `guard_blocked`, `provider_error_4xx/5xx`, `below_threshold`, …), but that classification only exists in transient log lines and the in-turn `/compact` reply. Once the turn is over, the outcome is gone: `/status` shows a bare `🧹 Compactions: N` counter, and an operator who wasn't watching the live session cannot answer "did the last compaction work, and if not, why?" — even though failing or perpetually-skipped compaction is a common root cause of the context-overflow symptoms they are trying to diagnose.

## Why This Change Was Made

The reason classification, the persisted `SessionEntry`, and the `/status` renderer all already exist — the missing piece is persisting the last classified outcome onto the session entry the way sibling diagnostics already do (`memoryFlushLastFailedAt` / `memoryFlushLastFailureError` follow exactly this pattern).

This change adds three optional `SessionEntry` fields (`lastCompactionAt`, `lastCompactionOutcome`, `lastCompactionReason`) and stamps them at the seams where a compaction attempt concludes with a known outcome:

- **successful compactions**: `incrementCompactionCount` (manual `/compact`, preflight/budget compaction), the post-run reconcile handler (live-run auto compactions), the gateway `sessions.compact` RPC (both the LLM branch and the `maxLines` transcript-trim branch), and the CLI-session compaction/finalize paths
- **failed/skipped attempts**: a new `recordCompactionOutcome` helper (same store mechanics as `incrementCompactionCount`, with `preserveActivity: true` so a failed attempt does not count as session activity), called from manual `/compact` and the preflight/budget compaction path; the gateway compact RPC stamps the same fields directly in its existing `updateSessionStore` mutations (LLM failed/skipped branch and trim no-op paths), where the store write already lives

Consistency guards (all verified by focused tests):

- **No resurrection**: a metadata-only failed/skipped stamp never creates a row, in memory or on disk — a session deleted/reset while compaction was in flight stays deleted (`recordCompactionOutcome` passes no `fallbackEntry` and mirrors to memory only after the persisted patch confirms the row exists).
- **No out-of-order regression**: every writer that captures its timestamp before awaiting the store writer applies the stamp through `isCompactionStampCurrent`, so a delayed older attempt cannot overwrite a newer outcome; full-entry finalizer patches (`updateSessionStoreAfterAgentRun`, `recordCliCompactionInStore`) strip the pre-run `lastCompaction*` snapshot so merging stale metadata cannot roll the fields back.
- Only the classified bucket is persisted — raw provider error text stays out of durable session metadata.

`/status` then renders a null-conditional suffix on the existing counter line:

```
🧹 Compactions: 3 (last: failed — summary_failed, 5m ago)
🧹 Compactions: 4 (last: compacted just now)
```

Sessions without the new fields render exactly as before. The three skip-class buckets were consolidated into a shared `isCompactionSkipClassification` helper (previously duplicated in two files, now needed by a third call site). Observer-only: no compaction behavior changes, no new config surface, no schema migration (optional fields on the existing store entry, reserved in `session-entry-slot-keys` per its compile-time guard).

## User Impact

Operators can diagnose compaction problems after the fact from `/status` instead of having to reproduce them while watching logs. "Context keeps overflowing" support cases become answerable with one command: the status line now distinguishes "compaction is failing (`summary_failed`)" from "compaction keeps being skipped (`below_threshold`)" from "compaction works fine". Sessions that predate the change show the unchanged bare counter.

## Evidence

HEAD: `0797012ddbc598b9d63b2512e0c80a0162c64267` (rebased onto upstream/main `8d535fb039`; clean rebase, patch content unchanged)

Real behavior proof (no mocks — production `recordCompactionOutcome`/`incrementCompactionCount` persisting through the real session-store patch path to an isolated `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR` file, rendered by the production `buildStatusMessage`; captured 2026-07-03 at this HEAD):

```
=== BEFORE (no outcome tracked yet) ===
📚 Context: ?/200k · 🧹 Compactions: 2

=== ACTION 1: production recordCompactionOutcome(failed, summary_failed) ===
persisted entry fields: {
  compactionCount: 2,
  lastCompactionAt: 1783047156063,
  lastCompactionOutcome: 'failed',
  lastCompactionReason: 'summary_failed',
  updatedAt: 1783047155879
}
📚 Context: ?/200k · 🧹 Compactions: 2 (last: failed — summary_failed, just now)

=== ACTION 2: production incrementCompactionCount (successful compaction) ===
persisted entry fields: {
  compactionCount: 3,
  lastCompactionAt: 1783047156077,
  lastCompactionOutcome: 'compacted',
  lastCompactionReason: undefined
}
📚 Context: ?/200k · 🧹 Compactions: 3 (last: compacted just now)
```

(`updatedAt` 1783047155879 predates the failed-stamp `lastCompactionAt` 1783047156063 — the failed attempt did not count as session activity.)

Focused tests (all green locally at this HEAD):

- `src/auto-reply/reply/session-updates.test.ts` — 7 (6 new: success stamp + stale-reason clear, zero-amount no-stamp, failed/skipped record without `updatedAt` churn, deleted-row no-resurrection on disk and in memory, delayed-older-attempt no-overwrite, unknown-session no-op)
- `src/status/status-message.test.ts` — 5 (3 new: failed render with bucket, compacted render, legacy bare counter)
- `src/auto-reply/reply/commands-compact.test.ts` — 12 (skip outcome recorded with `below_threshold`, failed outcome recorded with `summary_failed`)
- `src/config/sessions/session-accessor.test.ts` — transcript-trim compaction stamps outcome (extended existing trim test)
- `src/agents/command/session-store.test.ts`, `src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.compaction.test.ts`, `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/compact-reasons.test.ts`, `src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-memory*.test.ts`, `src/gateway/server.sessions.compaction.test.ts` — all green
- `pnpm tsgo:core` + `pnpm tsgo:core:test` clean; changed-scope test fanout green (`OPENCLAW_CHECK_CHANGED_REMOTE_CHILD=1`, capped workers; the default-worker run on this host hit vitest worker OOM, an environment limit, not a diff failure)
- External structured review: Codex (GPT-5.5) closeout loop, 7 rounds — 5 accepted findings fixed (deleted-row resurrection on disk / in memory, delayed out-of-order stamps, stale full-entry patch rollback, gateway trim-path coverage), final round clean: "patch is correct", no actionable findings

Known limits: auto-compaction failures that happen *inside* a live embedded run surface through the run's own failure path and are not stamped by this PR (only successful-count reconciliation exists at that seam today); the stamped seams cover manual `/compact`, gateway RPC compact (LLM + trim), preflight/budget compaction, and CLI compaction.

Non-scope: no compaction behavior/retry changes; no new config; no fix for #49380 ("Plugin context engines cannot increment /status compaction count" — a different ask about count accuracy for plugin-owned engines); `openclaw status` CLI (status-all) surface unchanged — this touches the chat `/status` renderer where the counter already lives.

---

🤖 AI-assisted (Claude Fable 5 + Codex GPT-5.5 review loop). Prompts: translate agentic-coding-tool observability patterns (Claude Code changelog: compaction outcome visibility) into a narrow OpenClaw `/status` improvement; implementation, tests, structured review rounds, and the real-behavior proof were run locally as described above.
